user.title: Add PV Site
user.description:
Enter the API key and system ID from pvoutput.org (Settings → API Settings). The status interval and donor status are read from your account.

After setup, open **Configure** to choose which sensors are sent.

data_description.api_key: Needs write access (API access enabled in PVOutput).
data_description.system_id: The numeric ID of the system the statuses belong to.

error.invalid_auth: PVOutput refused the API key or system ID.

abort.already_configured: This PVOutput system is already set up.

init.title: PVOutput Uploader
init.description:
Account: **{account}**, PVOutput status interval {detected_interval} min.

**Fields**
{fields}

Upload fields are recorded every 5 minutes into the history log; only **active** (Send) ones are sent. Download fields are read from PVOutput into sensors. **Fields** sets each one to Send, Record only or Download. **Reupload history** sends recorded days again (e.g. after making a field active); **Import history** fills the log for a time before the integration was installed. Each action saves when you submit it.

add_field.title: Add field
add_field.description:
Where does the value come from?

- **A sensor**: a Home Assistant sensor, recorded every 5 minutes, e.g. a temperature or battery power.
- **A fixed value**: the same number in every status, e.g. the battery size (b3).
- **From PVOutput**: read the field's latest value from PVOutput into a sensor (download, nothing is sent).

add_download.title: Add field from PVOutput
add_download.description: The field's latest value is read from PVOutput (getstatus) once per upload interval into a sensor named after the field and its name, e.g. *v2 Power from PVOutput*, next to a Normalised output sensor. Battery fields (b1-b6) are not returned by PVOutput, so they are not listed; extended fields (v7-v12) need a donor account. To upload the field later, set it to Send under **Fields** and give it a sensor or fixed value.

data_description.name: Optional; defaults to PVOutput's name for the field.
data_description.source_unit: Only for user-defined extended fields (v7-v12), which have no fixed unit.

add_sensor.title: Add sensor field
add_sensor.description: Pick the sensor and the PVOutput field it fills. Only fields not used yet are listed; extended (v7-v12) and battery (b1-b6) fields need a donor account. **b1 (battery power) is mandatory for battery data**: PVOutput ignores b2-b6 without it, so they are listed once b1 is added.

data_description.entity_id: Its unit is converted for PVOutput (kWh to Wh, kW to W, °F to °C).
data_description.field: v1/v3 energy, v2/v4 power, v5 temperature, v6 voltage, v7-v12 extended, b1-b6 battery.

sensor_details.title: {field}
sensor_details.description: From `{entity}`. The upload unit is shown in the field selector.

data_description.name: For your reference; use the label the field has in PVOutput.
data_description.active: Off (passive): recorded in the history log but not sent. Make it active later and reupload to send its history.
data_description.aggregate: How the 5 minute values of an interval are combined. Energy since midnight needs an energy sensor (Wh/kWh); lifetime and daily counters both work.
data_description.source_unit: For sensors without a unit, enter the actual source unit (e.g. kW, kWh, °C or °F). A sensor's reported unit takes precedence. Fixed values use PVOutput's unit; this sets the unit only for user-defined extended fields.

add_constant.title: Add fixed value
add_constant.description: Sent with every status. It is not recorded, and never sends a status on its own. Battery fields (e.g. b3 battery size) are listed once b1 (battery power) is added: PVOutput ignores them without it.

data_description.constant: In PVOutput's unit for the field, e.g. Wh for battery size. Leave empty for b6 (battery state): you pick the state from a list on the next screen.
data_description.name: Optional; defaults to PVOutput's name for the field.
data_description.active: Off: kept in the configuration but not sent.
data_description.source_unit: For sensors without a unit, enter the actual source unit (e.g. kW, kWh, °C or °F). A sensor's reported unit takes precedence. Fixed values use PVOutput's unit; this sets the unit only for user-defined extended fields.

battery_state.title: b6 · Battery State
battery_state.description: The battery state sent with every status. PVOutput defines codes 0-4; 5-9 are free for your own meaning.

edit_details.title: {field}
edit_details.description: Changes apply to new values; recorded history keeps what was logged. A field downloaded from PVOutput keeps its sensor or fixed value here, used when it is set back to Send or Record only; a field added from PVOutput can be given one (leave both empty to keep it download only).

data_description.aggregate: How the 5 minute values of an interval are combined.
data_description.source_unit: For sensors without a unit, enter the actual source unit (e.g. kW, kWh, °C or °F). A sensor's reported unit takes precedence. Fixed values use PVOutput's unit; this sets the unit only for user-defined extended fields.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description:
{fields}

- **Send**: recorded and sent to PVOutput (active).
- **Record only**: recorded, not sent (passive); its history can be sent later with Reupload history.
- **Download**: read from PVOutput into a sensor; nothing is sent. The sensor or fixed value stays configured, so switching back restores it.

A field added from PVOutput has no source yet: setting it to Send or Record only asks for one next. Each field also has a select on the device page.

field_source.title: {field}
field_source.description: {field} has no source in Home Assistant yet. Pick a sensor or enter a fixed value to upload it.

data_description.entity_id: Recorded every 5 minutes; how its values are combined can be changed under Edit field.
data_description.constant: Sent with every status, in PVOutput's unit for the field.

remove_field.title: Remove fields
remove_field.description: Removed fields stop being recorded and sent. What was recorded stays in the log.

reupload.title: Reupload history
reupload.description:
Waiting to be sent: {pending} samples. Rejected by PVOutput: {failed}. Sent without values PVOutput rejected: {partial}. Too old to send as statuses: {expired}. First unsent: **{first_unsent}**.

Statuses that could not be sent (uploading switched off, PVOutput or network errors, rate limit) are sent automatically when uploading can continue. Use this to send again what PVOutput rejected, or any period from a chosen time, like IoTaWatt's reload.

Sending runs in the background at the pace PVOutput's hourly request limit allows. Statuses can be sent for the last {status_days} days; older days only as daily totals (energy, peak power, min/max temperature).

data_description.passive_fields: Passive fields are recorded but not sent. Ticked ones are sent too, for the statuses of this period only; live statuses keep them off. Donor and battery rules still apply (battery fields need b1).
data_description.start: Used with "From a date and time".
data_description.end: Statuses up to this date and time are sent (that one included). Defaults to now.
data_description.method: Statuses keep every interval; daily totals replace the day's totals in PVOutput.

import_history.title: Import history from Home Assistant
import_history.description: Fills the history log from Home Assistant's recorder: 5 minute detail where recorded states still exist (10 days by default), hourly long term statistics for whatever is still missing. Values already in the log are kept; missing slots and fields are filled. Only sensor fields are imported, active and passive.

data_description.overwrite: Off: values already in the log are kept, only gaps are filled. On: periods are rebuilt from recorded states.
data_description.upload: Off: only stored in the log, ready for a later reupload. On: sent like any backlog (statuses within the PVOutput window).
data_description.passive_fields: With Send to PVOutput on, the ticked passive fields are sent too, for this period only (statuses PVOutput already has are sent again to add them); live statuses keep them off.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: PVOutput reports: {detected_account} account, {detected_interval} minute status interval.

data.output_fallback: Send daily totals for statuses too old to upload

data_description.donor_mode: Donor accounts can send extended (v7-v12) and battery fields, upload 90 days back and 100 statuses per request.
data_description.upload_interval: Should match the status interval of the system in PVOutput. The history log always records 5 minute values.
data_description.retention_days: Default 91: the 90 days PVOutput takes statuses from donors, plus today. Older rows are deleted once a day; keep more to be able to resend older days as daily totals. How long the integration can be stopped and still catch up with full detail depends on Home Assistant's recorder (purge_keep_days, 10 days by default), not on this setting.
data_description.output_fallback: When statuses could not be sent in time (e.g. after a long outage), send that day's totals as a daily output instead. This replaces the day's totals in PVOutput.

error.unit_mismatch: The sensor's unit does not fit this field.
error.field_unavailable: This PVOutput field is already configured (or not available for this account). The list now shows only the fields still free.
error.b1_required: b1 (battery power) is mandatory while other battery fields (b2-b6) are configured: PVOutput ignores them without it. Remove them too, or keep b1.
error.end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
error.nothing_unsent: Everything recorded has been sent. Choose a date and time instead.
error.start_required: Enter the date and time to start from.
error.unit_required: This sensor has no unit. Enter its source unit before saving.
error.entity_or_constant: Pick either a sensor or a fixed value (one of them).
error.mode_not_allowed: Not available for this field any more (e.g. the account is no longer a donor, which v7-v12 need to download). The page now shows what is.

abort.no_free_fields: Every PVOutput field this PV site can send is already configured. Edit or remove a field to change what is sent; extended and battery fields need a donor account.
abort.field_unavailable: {field} was added to this PV site in the meantime, so it was not added again. Open Configure to edit it.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Check that it has started, then try again.
abort.reupload_queued: Queued: {status_days} days as statuses, {output_days} days as daily totals. Progress shows in the Samples waiting and Daily outputs waiting sensors.
abort.import_done: Imported {from_states} samples from recorded states and {from_statistics} from statistics.

options.since_failure: Since the first unsent status (waiting, rejected, partly sent, cleared or too old)

options.auto: Statuses where allowed, daily totals for older days

select_entry.message: Choose which PVOutput system to use.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

start_required.message: Give a start, or set since_failure.

mode_not_allowed.message: {field} cannot be set to {mode}. Allowed now: {allowed}. A field added from PVOutput needs a sensor or fixed value (Configure) before Send or Record only; downloading v7-v12 needs a donor account.

reupload.name: Reupload history
reupload.description: Sends recorded history again. Days inside PVOutput's status window (14 days, 90 for donors) are sent as statuses, older days as daily outputs. Also available under Configure.

config_entry_id.name: PVOutput system
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one system is set up.

passive_fields.name: Passive fields
passive_fields.description: Passive fields (recorded, not sent) to send too, for the statuses of this period only, e.g. v7 or b2.

without_battery.name: Without battery
without_battery.description: Send everything waiting up to now without battery values (b1-b6). No longer needed for speed, as battery values are batched too; kept for compatibility.

since_failure.name: Since first unsent
since_failure.description: Start at the oldest status not confirmed by PVOutput (waiting, rejected or too old). Replaces the start.

start.name: Start
start.description: Date, or date and time, to send from.

end.name: End date
end.description: A date and time (statuses up to it), or a day (up to its end). Defaults to today.

import_from_recorder.name: Import from recorder
import_from_recorder.description: Fills the history log from Home Assistant's recorded states, and from hourly long term statistics where states have been purged. Also available under Configure.

config_entry_id.name: PVOutput system
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one system is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period to import.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace samples already in the log with values from recorded states.

upload.name: Upload
upload.description: Send the imported samples to PVOutput. Off keeps them in the log only.

passive_fields.name: Passive fields
passive_fields.description: With upload on, passive fields to send too, for this period only, e.g. v7 or b2.
